test_is_package_available: test whether a given package is installed in the current Python environment
test_is_notebook: test whether the code is currently running inside a Jupyter notebook or similar interactive shell
test_is_google_colab: test whether the code is currently running inside a Google Colab environment
test_is_pydantic_available: test whether Pydantic is installed and can be successfully imported without errors
test_dump_environment_info: dump comprehensive environment and dependency information for debugging purposes
